newsitem.title: USA: Moody's puts Rhone-Poulenc under review.
newsitem.headline: Moody's puts Rhone-Poulenc under review.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said Thursday that it has placed Rhone-Poulenc SA and its subsidiaries under review for a possible downgrade of its credit ratings.

The review was prompted by the company's announcement that it is planning to purchase the 31.7 percent minority stake in Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc and that it intends to restructure and partially float its Chemicals and Fibres & Polymers businesses, Moody's said.

Moody's said that the ratings placed under review for possible downgrade include Rhone-Poulenc SA, Rhone-Poulenc Commercial Finance BV, Rhone-Poulenc Commercial Finance Inc, Rhone-Poulenc Overseas Ltd, Rhone-Poulenc Rorer Inc and Fisons Plc.
The ratings service said in a news release that it placed those areas under review because of the "large amount of debt" the company is "likely to incur" to acquire the minority stake.

Moody's said the review will focus on the likely effect of the two major restructuring transactions would have on the company's debt levels. It said it also wants to assess Rhone-Poulenc's "future financial flexibility."
